objectives_fil: Mailarawan kung paano mag-anyaya ng pakikilahok at magdala ng obserbasyon sa lokal na pagpaplano.
objectives_en: Describe how to invite participation and bring observations into local planning.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ugnayan at komunikasyon ang simula ng sama-samang pagkilos.
sections.takeaway_en: Relationships and communication begin collective action.

sections.takeaway_fil: Makinig sa tugon; buuin ang gawain kasama ang mga residente.
sections.takeaway_en: Listen to responses; shape the activity with residents.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ibahagi ang ebidensya, hindi ang hinalang parang tiyak na katotohanan.
sections.takeaway_en: Share evidence without presenting assumptions as established facts.

sections.takeaway_fil: Local Investment Plan for Health: may ambag ang barangay; kumpirmahin ang lokal na proseso.
sections.takeaway_en: Local Investment Plan for Health: barangays contribute; confirm the local process.

sections.takeaway_fil: Mag-ugnay ng tao, mag-anyaya ng pagkilos, at dalhin ang obserbasyon sa pagpaplano.
sections.takeaway_en: Connect people, invite action, and bring observations into planning.

check.prompt_fil: Alin ang malinaw na gawaing pang-organisa?
check.prompt_en: Which is a clear organizing action?

options.fil: I-post ang plano at huwag nang humingi ng tugon.
options.en: Post the plan without inviting responses.

options.fil: Pangakuan ng pondo ang bawat mungkahi.
Anyayahan ang residente at health staff na magplano mula sa obserbasyon.
options.en: Invite residents and health staff to plan using observations.

check.feedback_fil: May ugnayan, pakikilahok, at ambag sa pagpaplano. Hindi awtomatikong paglalaan ng pondo ang LIPH link.
check.feedback_en: This combines relationships, participation, and planning input. The LIPH connection does not guarantee funding.

assets.alt_en: Teaching, community discussion, and guiding a resident.
